description: This file contains the implementation of a crit-bit (cursor-based radix) tree data structure, including functions for inserting, looking up, and traversing nodes within the tree.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_node_of(const void * p)
methods.description: Converts a pointer with embedded node info into a pointer to a cb_node struct.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_internal_best_match(struct cb_node * p,const uint8_t * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Finds the best matching node in the tree for a given key segment without performing a final comparison.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_insert(struct cb_tree * t,struct cb_node * node,size_t klen)
methods.description: Inserts a node into the crit-bit tree or returns an existing node if a duplicate exists.

methods.name: struct:cb_node * cb_lookup(struct cb_tree * t,const uint8_t * k,size_t klen)
methods.description: Searches the tree for a node matching a specified key.

methods.name: enum:cb_next cb_descend(struct cb_node * p,cb_iter fn,void * arg)
methods.description: Recursively traverses the tree applying a callback function to each node.

methods.name: void cb_each(struct cb_tree * t,const uint8_t * kpfx,size_t klen,cb_iter fn,void * arg)
methods.description: Traverses the tree and applies a callback function to each node matching a given prefix.

ctags.name: cb_descend
ctags.pattern: /^static enum cb_next cb_descend(struct cb_node *p, cb_iter fn, void *arg)$/

ctags.name: cb_each
ctags.pattern: /^void cb_each(struct cb_tree *t, const uint8_t *kpfx, size_t klen,$/
ctags.signature: (struct cb_tree * t,const uint8_t * kpfx,size_t klen,cb_iter fn,void * arg)

ctags.name: cb_insert
ctags.pattern: /^struct cb_node *cb_insert(struct cb_tree *t, struct cb_node *node, size_t klen)$/

ctags.name: cb_lookup
ctags.pattern: /^struct cb_node *cb_lookup(struct cb_tree *t, const uint8_t *k, size_t klen)$/
